The '''Bissillirus Resupply Base''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]].

==Characteristics==
The station was 200 meters in diameter and 1,500 meters tall. It was crewed by 376 support and administrative personnel, 36 pilots, and 60 gunners. The base had consumables for one year and was defended by 20 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery turrets, a reinforced [[Hull/Legends|hull]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], two squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and 608 [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]]. The station housed three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] and two [[Regulator X-Q2 System Patrol Cruiser]]s. With six [[Hangar/Legends|landing bays]] and two docking bays, the Bissillirus Resupply Base could provide berth and service for eight large transports and 1,750 people at any time. The base was built in 14 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].
